Generation mode: built-in image_gen

bg_lobby / 大厅纯背景
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean reusable full-screen background texture for a mobile word game.
The provided image is the edit target. Remove EVERY UI overlay and reconstruct ONLY the photograph underneath, preserving the exact photo, camera perspective, crop, mountain silhouettes, natural rock and fog details, cloud layers, natural light and foreground depth of field.
Output one edge-to-edge portrait 9:16 natural travel photograph, full resolution. No phone frame, no outer canvas.
Remove all typography including WordTile, Alps, chapter and progress text, levels, location, numbers, coin count, captions. Remove ALL icons, answer slots, game tiles, outlined empty cells, rounded buttons, badges, chevrons, divider marks, panels, and every milky or frosted blur patch caused by those controls. Reconstruct sharp photographic texture at the original depth of field beneath them. There must be NO residual letters, shadows shaped like UI, rectangular holes or ghost buttons.
The actual landscape must remain the same real photographic Italian Alpine scene. Do not turn it into painting or watercolor, do not add a new mountain, change time of day, add people or a lake. Fill the former overlay regions from their exact surrounding sky, rock, grass and clouds.
This target is the LOBBY image. Carefully remove the central title group, top HUD, lower Continue action and bottom Dictionary action, filling all of them with matching original photographic content.

bg_level / 关卡纯背景
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean reusable full-screen background texture for a mobile word game.
The provided image is the edit target. Remove EVERY UI overlay and reconstruct ONLY the photograph underneath, preserving the exact photo, camera perspective, crop, mountain silhouettes, natural rock and fog details, cloud layers, natural light and foreground depth of field.
Output one edge-to-edge portrait 9:16 natural travel photograph, full resolution. No phone frame, no outer canvas.
Remove all typography including WordTile, Alps, chapter and progress text, levels, location, numbers, coin count, captions. Remove ALL icons, answer slots, game tiles, outlined empty cells, rounded buttons, badges, chevrons, divider marks, panels, and every milky or frosted blur patch caused by those controls. Reconstruct sharp photographic texture at the original depth of field beneath them. There must be NO residual letters, shadows shaped like UI, rectangular holes or ghost buttons.
The actual landscape must remain the same real photographic Italian Alpine scene. Do not turn it into painting or watercolor, do not add a new mountain, change time of day, add people or a lake. Fill the former overlay regions from their exact surrounding sky, rock, grass and clouds.
This target is the GAMEPLAY image. Carefully remove top HUD, answer cells and progress, shuffle/hint buttons, all nine lower letter tiles and lower-left Bonus control. Reconstruct their full underlying fog, mountains and foreground.

glass_primary / 主按钮透明底图
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: a single reusable TRANSPARENT RGBA 2D game UI skin, not a screenshot.
Use the provided game screen ONLY to match the selected control's shape and very restrained frosted-glass edge language. Isolate ONE EMPTY flat UI surface. All letters, numerals, icons, badges, captions, controls other than the requested surface, scenery and original photographic colors must be removed.
The output must have a genuinely transparent background. This is a shader OVERLAY texture: the interior should be softly translucent neutral near-white with meaningful alpha around 40–60%, so a separately supplied background can be seen through it. Fine translucent white edge highlight and a tiny soft neutral shadow only. Do not bake any mountain, sky, grass, landscape texture, colored reflection or blur patch into this reusable skin. Do NOT make it opaque solid white, a checkerboard image, glossy 3D physical glass, beveled toy plastic or a glass window in a scene.
No text, no numbers, no logos, no icons anywhere. One object only, orthographic front view, centered with modest transparent padding. Soft neutral color, exceptionally light visual weight.
Selected surface: the wide horizontal Continue button near the bottom of the lobby. One empty low rounded rectangle, approximately 5.2:1 width-to-height ratio, restrained corner radius about 0.2 of its height. Empty interior across its full width. Preserve this simple silhouette, not a capsule with semicircular ends. No surrounding screenshot.
